title: Lepsius, Denkmäler VI pl. 118: papyrus from Thebes no. VII, right column (detail)

object.name: Papyrus from Thebes no. VII (Lepsius, Denkmäler Abth. VI, Bl. 118)

source.attribution: Karl Richard Lepsius, Denkmäler aus Aegypten und Aethiopien (1849); scan by the New York Public Library, via Wikimedia Commons

notes: Lithographic facsimile (hand-drawn copy printed in colour), not a photograph. The plate prints the text sideways; this crop was rotated 90° so the lines run horizontally. Plate caption cropped out; small printed line numbers (28, 36) remain. No date given by the source.
